messages.subject: [Mailman] administrative access to the Zelig-commits mailing list
messages.subject_clean: [Mailman] administrative access to the Zelig-commits mailing list
messages.body_plain:
Hello!  This is Steve Huff; I'm a systems administrator at the
Harvard-MIT Data Center (http://www.hmdc.harvard.edu).

We provide support for, among others, the group that develops the Zelig
R module (http://gking.harvard.edu/zelig).  Some time ago one of my
colleagues configured the "Zelig-commits" list
(https://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/cgi-bin/mailman/listinfo/zelig-commits)
on your Mailman system to track CVS commits; however, he is now leaving
our group, and he does not remember the credentials that he used at the
time.

There are several spam messages currently in the moderation queue for
that list, and we'd like to clear them out (and change the list
configuration so that this issue does not recur).  Would you be willing
to add me as a list administrator, or at least tell me what address is
configured as a list administrator, so that I can use the password
reminder function to recover the password?

You can contact me at this address, or by sending mail to
<support at help.hmdc.harvard.edu>.

thanks,
-Steve

-- 
Steve Huff - Systems Administrator, HMDC - shuff at hmdc.harvard.edu
